verdicts_or_reports.field: album list: IrisSeed item count / album count
verdicts_or_reports.expected: One album "IrisSeed" with 2 items (big.jpg, huge_r.jpg) after renaming huge.jpg to huge_r.jpg.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: IrisSeed now appears as two separate album tiles, each "IrisSeed" with "1 items"; the IrisSeed album view shows only big.jpg.
steps: Start with album IrisSeed holding big.jpg and huge.jpg (Albums shows one tile 'IrisSeed', 2 items).
Tap the IrisSeed tile, tap huge.jpg, tap the Details icon.
Tap Rename, change the name to huge_r, tap Rename. Sheet shows File name huge_r.jpg.
Close the sheet, tap Back to return to the IrisSeed album: only big.jpg is shown.
Tap Back to the Albums tab: two tiles are listed, both 'IrisSeed' with '1 items'.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: One album tile "IrisSeed" with "2 items" (the album still holds both photos after the rename).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After renaming huge.jpg to huge_r.jpg, the Albums tab shows two tiles both labelled "IrisSeed" with "1 items" each (huge_r.jpg tile and big.jpg tile). This persists after switching Media/Favorites/Albums tabs. Opening the IrisSeed album shows only big.jpg.
steps: Precondition: Albums tab shows one tile 'IrisSeed' with '2 items'.
Open IrisSeed, tap huge.jpg, tap Details (top-right icon).
In File information tap Rename, clear the name, type huge_r, tap Rename. File name now shows huge_r.jpg.
Tap the close control on the sheet, then Back to the Albums tab.
Observe: two 'IrisSeed' tiles with '1 items' each. Switch to Media and back to Albums: still two tiles.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: EXIF & Metadata Editor (Origin tab), opened from photo Details for big.jpg
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Captured shows 2019-03-05 10:20 after Save, and the photo Details sheet shows that as the capture date (EXIF-based).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After typing 2019-03-05 10:20 and tapping Save, the sheet closes. Reopening Edit metadata & EXIF > Origin shows the Captured field empty again, and the Details sheet still lists only Added and Modified (November 14, 2026 · 2:34 AM), with no capture date.
steps: Open album IrisSeed (Albums tab), tap big.jpg, tap the Details icon (top right).
Tap 'Edit metadata & EXIF', then tap the Origin tab.
Tap the Captured field, type 2019-03-05 10:20, tap Save. Sheet returns to Details.
Tap 'Edit metadata & EXIF' again, tap Origin: Captured is empty.
Details sheet has no capture-date row; header still shows 'November 14 · 2:34 AM'.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: EXIF & Metadata Editor (Origin tab) for big.jpg
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After Save, reopening Origin shows the saved Captured value, and the Details sheet reports the EXIF capture date.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Failed twice. (1) Typed 2019-03-05 10:20, Save: reopen shows Captured empty. (2) Set Current Time gave 2026-11-14 02:36:45, Save: reopen shows Captured empty again. Details sheet never shows a capture-date row; it only lists Added and Modified.
steps: Open album IrisSeed, tap big.jpg, tap Details icon.
Tap 'Edit metadata & EXIF', tap Origin tab.
Tap 'Set Current Time' (Captured shows 2026-11-14 02:36:45), tap Save; sheet returns to Details.
Tap 'Edit metadata & EXIF', tap Origin: Captured is empty.
Repeat with typed value 2019-03-05 10:20: also empty after reopen.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After renaming huge.jpg to huge_r.jpg, the viewer title reads "1 of 2 · huge_r.jpg" (same as the filmstrip and File name in Details).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Title reads "1 of 2 · huge" while the filmstrip thumbnail is huge_r.jpg and the Details File name is huge_r.jpg. Before the rename the title was "2 of 2 · big.jpg" (file name with extension).
steps: Open album IrisSeed, tap huge.jpg, tap Details, tap Rename, enter huge_r, tap Rename. File name shows huge_r.jpg.
Close the sheet. Viewer title shows '1 of 2 · huge'.
Swipe or tap the big.jpg thumbnail and back: title shows '2 of 2 · big.jpg' (with extension) for unrenamed photo, so renamed title is inconsistent.
